_comment: ai_ops hooks template. Copy content into .claude/settings.local.json at workspace root. SessionStart is read-only; PreToolUse includes the owner-applied blocking workspace guard plus an advisory Level 4 warning. The dynamic PostToolUse npx Markdown hook is intentionally disabled pending an integrity-controlled local replacement.

hooks.command: python -c "import json,sys; p=json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); print('[GOVERNANCE GUARD] Level 4 path detected: '+p+' — verify explicit L4 approval exists before proceeding.') if any(x in p.replace('\\','/') for x in ('00_Admin/policies/','00_Admin/specs/','00_Admin/configs/','AGENTS.md','CONTRIBUTING.md','.ai_ops/workflows/')) else None"

echo "{\"additionalContext\": \"Branch: $(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo none). Active artifacts: $(grep -c 'type:' ai_ops/.ai_ops/local/work_state.yaml 2>/dev/null || echo 0) in work_state.yaml.\"}"
